comment.description: Comment associated to the prompt injection observation.

deployment-context.description: Type of AI application that was targeted by the injection attempt.

detection-method.description: How the injection attempt was detected or observed.

first-seen.description: First time the injection attempt was observed.

last-seen.description: Last time the injection attempt was observed.

mitigation.description: Mitigation or defensive measure applied against this injection technique.

model-response.description: Summary or excerpt of the model's response to the injection attempt.

prompt-text.description: The observed malicious prompt text (as entered or generated by the attacker).

reference.description: External reference (write-up, report, or advisory) documenting this injection technique or campaign.

successful.description: True if the injection attempt succeeded (the model followed the injected instructions), false otherwise.

target-model.description: AI model targeted by the injection attempt.

technique.description: Prompt injection technique used by the attacker.

description: Object describing an observed prompt injection or jailbreak attempt against an AI system.
name: prompt-injection-observation
